name: hcapp_checkConnection
description: Unauthenticated end-to-end connectivity ping: returns one hardcoded row { result = 'Connected' } to confirm the app can reach the database through the API shim. No parameters, no auth, no side effects on success. The body is wrapped in TRY/CATCH (2026-07-19 audit): an unhandled error is written to HC.ErrorLog (HcVersion '<no device>', userId NULL) and re-raised with THROW. Note the API short-circuits this call with {"connected":true} without reaching SQL (see reference_checkconnection_contract).

rowsets.name: ConnectionResult
rowsets.description: Single hardcoded row returned on all calls.

sideEffects: None on success. INSERT HC.ErrorLog then THROW on an unhandled error.
breakingChanges: @deviceId (UNIQUEIDENTIFIER) parameter removed — was a dead input in HC5, never read or used.
@accessToken (NVARCHAR(1000)) parameter removed — was a dead input in HC5, never validated or used.
